articles.summary: Zacks: FDA Accepts BMY's NDA for Iberdomide Combo in Multiple Myeloma. FDA accepts and grants priority review to Bristol Myers' NDA for iberdomide combo in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. A decision is due on Aug. 17, 2026.
